name: Nord-Pas de Calais Mining Basin
description: In northern France, across the Nord and Pas-de-Calais departments, this sprawling landscape was shaped by three centuries of coal mining. Its 109 separate components include old pitheads, railway stations and mining villages with their schools, churches and managers' houses. The most striking features are the giant slag heaps, some over 140 metres high, which now rise like artificial mountains above the flat countryside.
